{{Quote|The Jedi&hellip;vexed me, Master Sinde! Still, he is brave&hellip;and his skills are impressive.|Sigel Dare, to Treis Sinde regarding Dan|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
'''Asaak Dan''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. He was present at the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order's]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cade Skywalker]] visited it in [[137 ABY]]. Skywalker looked to gain the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council's]] help in [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] [[Darth Krayt]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|his faction]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Empire. The Council refused, instead opting to oppose Krayt by allying with the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|remnants]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and the deposed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile|forces]]. Dan, along with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Masters [[Sayar Dun'La]], [[Te Corso]], and [[Drok]], was sent by the Council to meet with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], the leader of the Galactic Alliance Remnant. After Dan and his fellow Jedi boarded Stazi's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']], he volunteered to accompany the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Sigel Dare]] on a mission to retrieve her fellow Imperial Knight [[Treis Sinde]] from the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], which was under siege by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-Imperial forces.

When Dan and Dare located Sinde, the Imperial Knight refused to leave Dac since he was assisting the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]], who were fighting against the Sith-Imperials on Dac. After Dare and Sinde began to [[Incident on Dac|duel each other]], Dan intervened and managed to break up the fight. He volunteered to take Sinde's place with the Mon Calamari Rangers and bid the two Imperial Knights farewell. Shortly thereafter, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]]&mdash;who had assumed control of Krayt's Empire&mdash;ordered the execution of the [[Final Protocol]]. The Sith forces on Dac infected the planet's [[Water/Legends|oceans]] with [[Viral spore]]s that would eliminate all life on Dac within one [[Standard week/Legends|week]]. Dan and the Rangers captured the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Heurkea Floating City|Heurkea's]] docks and aided the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance fleet]] in their [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuation]] efforts, managing to rescue twenty percent of Dac's surviving population. The Jedi Master departed the planet on the last [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] with the Mon Calamari Ranger [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tanquar]].

==Biography==
===The Hidden Temple===
[[File:DareAndDanSuitUp-L42.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Dan and Imperial Knight Sigel Dare prepare to land on Dac]]
[[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Asaak Dan was a member of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] in [[137 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy 42" /> Dan lived in the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taivas]]&mdash;where the surviving [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had fled after the [[One Sith]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces [[Massacre at Ossus|massacred]] the Order on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] [[130 ABY|seven years]] previously&mdash;when the former Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Cade Skywalker]], son of [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]] member [[Kol Skywalker]], came to the Temple in order to ask for the Jedi's help in [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]]. The Council refused to aid Skywalker, instead opting to oppose Krayt by pursuing an alliance with the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and the [[Empire-in-exile|forces]] of the deposed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]].<ref name="Legacy 26">[[Legacy (2006) 26|''Legacy'' (2006) 26]]</ref>

===Mission to Dac===
{{Quote|If the Mon Calamari Rangers feel I would be of use, I will volunteer to take Master Sinde's place with them. Or we can all stay here, keep up this foolishness, and probably get captured or killed.''"<br />"''A good offer, Master Jedi. A wise one.|Dan and Treis Sinde|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
After Skywalker successfully [[Battle on Had Abbadon|assassinated]] Krayt, the Council sent Dan and fellow Jedi Masters [[Te Corso]], [[Sayar Dun'La]], and [[Drok]] to meet with [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] and discuss the possibility of the Jedi allying with his forces and Roan Fel's Empire-in-exile against the Sith. Dan and his companions journeyed to Stazi's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Alliance'']], and boarded the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in their [[X-83 TwinTail starfighter]]s. After disembarking, Dan and the Jedi were greeted by Stazi and several Alliance [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. During Stazi's ensuing conversation with Corso, the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Sigel Dare]], who represented Fel's Empire, interrupted Stazi. She asked the Admiral for permission to take one of his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] to the planet [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in order to retrieve her fellow Imperial Knight [[Treis Sinde]], who was working with the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] against the Sith-Imperial forces on Dac. Dan, who was interested in meeting Sinde, asked Dare if he could accompany her. She objected, but her conviction was overridden by Stazi.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

During the journey to Dac, Dare repeated to Dan the plan to meet with Sinde on five separate occasions. The two dressed as [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] officers in order to blend in with the local Imperials. As their shuttle was approaching Dac, Dan was given instructions by Dare yet again, and he reminded her that he was already aware of the plan. After disembarking in [[New Coral City/Legends|New Coral City]], Dare used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|persuade]] an Imperial officer that she and Dan were never officially on Dac. When Dan and Dare met with Sinde and [[Tanquar]],<ref name="Legacy 42" /> a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]],<ref name="Legacy 47">[[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]</ref> Sinde informed Dare that he would not be returning with her to [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], Emperor Fel's stronghold.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

[[File:DanDareSinde-Leg42.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Dan is attacked as he attempts to stop Sigel Dare and Treis Sinde from fighting each other.]]
After a brief argument, Dare and Sinde [[Incident on Dac|attacked each other]]. Dan ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and crossed blades with the Imperial Knights, stating that it was wrong for them to fight. This prompted both Sinde and Dare to attack Dan, who felt it was better for the Imperials to fight him. Dan [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] Dare away from him and asked if he could suggest an alternative to their solution, but Dare continued attacking the Jedi. During the skirmish, Dan told Sinde that he agreed with Dare about him returning to Bastion, stating that if Sinde truly felt that the Imperial Knights were losing their focus, the Force needed Sinde to return to instruct the Imperial Knights. The Jedi Master blocked Dare's attack while Force-pushing Sinde and gained the upper hand by pushing the Imperials into each other. After deactivating his lightsaber, Dan volunteered to take Sinde's place with the Mon Calamari Rangers, and Sinde agreed with Dan. Dan then bid farewell to both Sinde and Dare and left with Tanquar to help the Mon Calamari Rangers.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

===Evacuation of Dac===
{{Quote|You go with the rest of the Rangers, Master Dan. This is the last shuttle. My place is here&hellip;with those we cannot save&hellip;"''<br />"''I understand your feelings, Captain Tanquar, and they do you credit. However, like it or not, you are now one of the Mon Calamari leaders. Your place is with the living."''<br />"''Living is sometimes harder than dying, Asaak Dan."''<br />"''Yes. Those who remain understand. You must accept your destiny, my friend.|Tanquar and Dan|<ref name="Legacy 47" />}}
[[File:Rangers_vs_stormtroopers.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Dan fights Imperial stormtroopers alongside his Mon Calamari comrades]]
A short time later, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]], who had become the ruler of the Empire, ordered the execution of the [[Final Protocol]]. The Sith [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] infected Dac's [[Water/Legends|oceans]] with [[Viral spore]]s that would eliminate all life on the planet within [[Standard week/Legends|seven days]]. Three days after the Final Protocol's execution, the Galactic Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] known as [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] discovered that millions of beings had died, prompting Admiral Stazi to initiate a massive [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuation]] of the planet. Dan joined Captain Tanquar and the Mon Calamari Rangers in their takeover of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Heurkea Floating City|Heurkea's]] docks, which served as base for the evacuation efforts. The [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance fleet]] and a number of [[Emergency evac fleet|civilian volunteers]] managed to evacuate approximately twenty percent of the planet's population. As the last available shuttle prepared to depart, Dan convinced Tanquar that as a figure of leadership, the Captain had the responsibility to survive, and the two then departed Dac aboard the shuttle.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Do ''not'' condescend to me, Master Dan."''<br />"''Was I? I apologize. Mostly, I was ''enjoying'' you, Master Dare. You're so very&hellip;''Imperial''.|Sigel Dare and Dan|<ref name="Legacy 42" />}}
The Togruta Asaak Dan wore a set of [[brown]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and used a lightsaber containing a [[blue]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]]. He was trusted enough by the Jedi Council to be one of four Jedi sent to discuss the possibility of fighting alongside the Galactic Alliance Remnant and the Empire-in-exile against the Sith-Imperials. Dan was fascinated by the prospect of meeting Imperial Knight Treis Sinde, who had been working with the Mon Calamari Rangers against the Sith on Dac. This led Dan to ask Imperial Knight Sigel Dare if he could join her on her mission to retrieve Sinde from Dac.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

As their shuttle approached the planet, Dare began to inform him of their plan to get Sinde out of Dac quickly, but Dan pointed out to Dare that he was aware of the plan, since she had gone over it five times previously. After she retorted, Dan apologized to her, and stated that he was enjoying her company. Later, when Dare used a mind trick on an Imperial officer, Dan mocked her usage of the Force, stating that the Imperial mindset invited mind control. When Sinde and Dare got into an argument and attacked each other, Dan crossed his lightsaber with theirs in order to prevent them from fighting each other. He willingly volunteered to take Sinde's place among the Mon Calamari Rangers.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:Rough_sketch_Jedi_by_chrisscalf.jpg|thumb|right|150px|A cover concept sketch by Chris Calf, featuring Dan, Te Corso, Sayar Dun'La, and Drok]]
Asaak Dan was skilled at using a lightsaber during combat, and was capable of fending off two fully trained Imperial Knights. After he left to assist the Mon Calamari Rangers, Sigel Dare told Treis Sinde that Dan's skills were impressive. Dan utilized abilities with telekinetic [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]; he employed these skills against both Sinde and Dare.<ref name="Legacy 42" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dan first appeared on the cover for the [[Legacy (2006) 26|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Legacy: The Hidden Temple|''The Hidden Temple'']] story arc, drawn by [[Omar Francia]]. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]].<ref name="Legacy 26" /> Because of a surplus of characters in ''The Hidden Temple'' story arc, Dan, Corso, Dun'La, and Drok were not used in the comic itself. Dan and the other three Jedi were originally supposed to accompany Cade Skywalker in his assassination mission of Darth Krayt, against the wishes of the Jedi Council.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28816293|board=Literature|thread=Legacy #26: The Hidden Temple, part 2 (of 2)|user=[[John Ostrander|jfostrander01]]|date=2008-07-23|time=8:46 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180304152321/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/legacy-26-the-hidden-temple-part-2-of-2.28287244/page-4}}</ref>

Dan was first identified when he appeared in [[Legacy (2006) 42|''Divided Loyalties'']], the series' forty-second issue, which was drawn by [[Dave Ross]].<ref name="Legacy 42" /> and he was pencilled by [[Jan Duursema]] in [[Legacy (2006) 47|issue forty-seven]], ''The Fate of Dac''.<ref name="Legacy 47" />
